company.description:
Correlia Biosystems develops microscale tools that accelerate the rate of molecular interactions, allowing for measurements of biomolecules.

Correlia Biosystems is a UC Berkeley spinoff that creates protein measurement tools that are inexpensive, quick, and customizable. Their adaptable SimpleScan technology has a wide range of applications, from point-of-care diagnostics to rapid and multiplexed proteomics research.

productsAndServices.description: An automated platform for ligand binding assays, including ELISAs, that integrates with liquid handling robots and provides rapid, hands-free measurement of proteins and other biomolecules.
productsAndServices.name: PIXI Platform

productsAndServices.description: Pre-coated cartridges for the PIXI platform, available for specific assays such as human IgG and IL-1 beta, as well as customizable options for various target analytes.
productsAndServices.name: PIXI Cartridges

productsAndServices.description: Integrated software for the PIXI platform that analyzes ELISA results and generates data, supporting both off-the-shelf and user-customized assays.

aiResearchSummary.text: Correlia Biosystems is researching automated fluid sample processing systems. In Fluid removal for fluid sample processing systems, they describe an apparatus with an aspiration arm, manifold, and vacuum conduit to remove fluids from assay devices. System modules for use with fluid sample processing systems details modular aspiration, pneumatic, and control submodules that interface with chip modules containing assay devices, highlighting development of integrated fluid handling and modular assay processing.
